name: Undead Air
source:
Your radio show has gotten quite popular. By reporting on strange urban legends, conspiracies and scary stories, it has developed a cult following of fans, who regularly call on air to tell their delusions and stories.
On Devil's Night, a shady character calls:
"I will commit murder. One in each time zone. You will be the last victim."
Is it yet another pathological liar, or is there something more to their words?

[From [url=https://wandeer.itch.io/undead-air]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你的广播节目很受欢迎。通过报道奇怪的都市传说、阴谋和恐怖故事，它培养了一批狂热的粉丝，他们经常打电话来讲述他们的错觉和故事。
在恶魔之夜，一个阴暗的角色呼叫：
“我会杀人。每个时区都有一个。你将是最后一个受害者。”
又是一个病态的骗子，还是他们的话另有隐情？

[来自[url=https://wandeer.itch.io/undead-air]itch.io[/url]]
